extracted.finding: The prior researcher flagged the May 2026 TrumpRx expansion as an open staleness risk that might have changed GLP-1 pricing after the February launch. Index-mediated reading indicates the expansion's scope was GENERIC medicines, not GLP-1 repricing.

extracted.residual_staleness_risk: PARTIALLY REDUCED, NOT ELIMINATED.
